messages:
Ashley: Heads-up — planning a py/ts SDK publish in the 4h change window. QA canary flagged a signer header mismatch on ~2/5 requests, looks like `x-sdk-signer` v1 vs v2. Holding publish until we triage. Anyone able to take this?

Mike: Which canary tag is failing? I can spin up a repro.

Ashley: canary tag is `canary-2026-03-20-rc1`. Failures seen in both node and python clients. Short failure rate but reproducible.

DeployBot: canary-run start - tag=canary-2026-03-20-rc1 region=aws-us-west-2 instances=3 triggered_by=Ashley ts=1812398771

Jen: I repro locally. Minimal curl to reproduce: `curl -v -H "x-sdk-signer: v2" https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/sdk/health` returns 400 with error `unrecognized signer version`. Looks like validator dropped backward-compat check.

Naveen: That matches the change I shipped yesterday to hard-enforce the new signer during validation. I thought we had feature-flag coverage. Quick mitigation options: 1) relax validator to accept v1 for one release, 2) hotfix the validator to treat missing header as v1, 3) rollback the canary publish.

Sam: If the fix is one-line, we can hotpatch the validator and republish canary. If not, rollback. I can take the hotfix and republish within ~30m.

Ashley: Sam please take lead. Mike, prep rollback commands just in case. Add steps for npm/pypi pin and changelog entry.

Mike: Rollback snippet (ops doc):
```
# rollback py/ts SDK canary
deploybot rollback --package py-sdk --tag canary-2026-03-20-rc1 --reason "signer-mismatch" --force
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.4.3 canary
python -m pip index versions redwood-sdk  # confirm
```

Sam: Hotfix pushed to canary validator branch, tests green. Kicking a republish now (`release-tool publish --tag canary-2026-03-20-rc1 --skip-docs`).

DeployBot: publish started - package=py-sdk tag=canary-2026-03-20-rc1 triggered_by=Sam ts=1812398790

Mike: I also added a temporary compatibility test to the smoke suite that checks v1 and v2 signer headers. Will merge to main after this window.

Ashley: If republish succeeds, we still need a short deprecation note about signer v1 removal and an entry in release notes that we accepted v1 for this cycle. Please post the changelog snippet here after publish. Tagging @eng-releases for visibility. :thumbsup:

Sam: Publish finished, canary health now 0/100 errors. Pushing changelog: "Temporary compatibility: validator accepts legacy x-sdk-signer v1 for one release to allow staged migration. Full enforcement planned next release."

Ashley: Great — closing hold. Sam/Mike, follow up with a quick postmortem and a migration checklist for downstream integrators.

DeployBot: canary-run complete - tag=canary-2026-03-20-rc1 status=success duration=00:02:26 ts=1812398801
